name: Chronicle 2.0
tagline: AI-powered presentation builder that produces polished decks without the generic, over-designed look of typical AI tools.
problem: Most AI presentation tools churn out visually bland, templated slides that require heavy manual cleanup before they're client-ready. Chronicle 2.0 aims to give teams a faster path from idea to presentation while preserving design quality and brand integrity. This saves time for marketers, founders, and consultants who need compelling decks without a dedicated designer.
useCases: Building investor pitch decks with a polished, on-brand aesthetic
Creating internal team updates or strategy presentations quickly
Producing client-facing proposals or case study decks
Rapid prototyping of presentation concepts for review and iteration
